lines: Line numbers are those of the files on review-target.
matching: A finding is matched to a defect by the lines it cites, so a match credits the location, not the mechanism: a finding about something else on the same lines is credited too. Whether a finding names the planted failure is the judge's to read. `accepted` lists the severities a reviewer following its own rules may give a defect, where more than one is defensible.

defects.failure: When ADMIN_TOKEN is not set, a request with no x-admin-token header compares undefined with undefined and passes, so anyone can add a discount code, a 100 percent one included.
defects.acceptedWhy: Whether ADMIN_TOKEN is set is configuration, so a reviewer may rate the bypass PLAUSIBLE, at SHOULD FIX or Medium and below, as atk:security must.

defects.failure: The bulk discount applies only above ten units (quantity > BULK_MIN_QUANTITY), while the commit, the comment and the README promise it at ten units or more: a line of exactly ten is charged full price.
A bad request to POST /discount-codes answers with the error's stack trace, which exposes file paths and the code's structure to the caller.
The percent of a new code is never checked: 150 makes the discount larger than the subtotal and the total negative, and a string or a missing percent makes every total using the code NaN.
MAX_CODES is declared and never used, so it reads as a limit the code does not enforce.
